title: Chapter 169 The City Lord Is Back
content:
Chapter 169 The City Lord Is Back

Buzz —

At this moment, a mysterious force surged out of Lu Daosheng's hands.

Songzhe's figure was immediately imprisoned.

"What! This, this is impossible! Impossible!"

Songzhe's face was distorted. He didn't believe that his dignified person from the Palace of Nothingness would be crushed by an ant from the lower realm.

But no matter how I do, I can't move at all.

"Sister, brother-in-law, save me!! Save me!"

A fear surged in Songzhe's heart and he exclaimed quickly.

However, Song Yue just looked at this scene with a dull look.

Xu Wuzi's expression was even colder.

"Your Excellency, this person is at your disposal."

The cold words came into Songzhe's ears, and a chill suddenly swept across his body.

"Wait, wait, brother-in-law, I am your brother-in-law!"

Songzhe roared.

However, Xu Wuzi ignored it.

"Do you remember what you said?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke coldly.

Songzhe looked frightened, "This is the Palace of Void. Are you afraid of retribution if you kill me?"

At this moment, his slow mind finally turned around.

The man in front of me is someone he can't afford to offend.

He kicked the ball.

However, what responded to him was Lu Daosheng's contemptuous smile.

boom!

With Lu Daosheng's sudden force, Songzhe completely turned into a gorgeous blood rain, spraying the starry sky.

The hot blood splattered onto Song Yue's cheeks. Suddenly, Song Yue screamed and then lost consciousness.

Lu Daosheng ignored it and went straight towards Xuwuzi.

Seeing Lu Daosheng walking towards him.

Xu Wuzi, the lord of the power of order, actually felt a trace of inexplicable fear.

"Songzhe is dead, isn't you enough?"

Xu Wuzi's face looked a little ugly.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled faintly and said, "Don't be nervous, I just think that you lack management in the Void Palace and want to help you see it."

"you!"

Xu Wuzi's face became a little heavier.

He naturally knew what Lu Daosheng meant.

The other party actually wanted to reach out to their Palace of Nothingness.

What a joke!

boom!

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly took action.

A figure suddenly retreated tens of thousands of miles from the void.

"Lord of the Palace!!"

Everyone looked horrified.

In the distance, a stream of blood slowly overflowed from the corner of Xu Wuzi's mouth.

"Remember, if I don't kill you, it will be a blessing for you."

Lu Daosheng said coldly.

Hearing this, Xu Wuzi didn't speak.

But the hands hidden behind them were trembling wildly.

With just one blow, he understood that the man in front of him had strength far exceeding his own.

There are people outside of people, and there is heaven beyond heaven.

Even their orderly forces have unmatched opponents.

"Your Excellency, do you know the Lord of Origin?"

Xu Wuzi asked the last question.

Lu Daosheng chuckled and said, "What, do you want to use that old guy to suppress me?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's answer, Xu Wuzi looked horrified, and then looked up at the void in horror. Seeing that there was no reaction, Xu Wuzi immediately understood.

"Sir, I have offended you before I go down, so I hope you will forgive me."

A drop of cold sweat slowly slid from Xu Wuzi's cheeks.

I thought I was already very proud of the other party, but I didn't expect that the other party was even more terrifying than I thought.

Even the Master Yuanji didn't take it seriously.

Then in the other party's eyes, I was not even a big deal.

Damn, this damn brother-in-law actually provoked such an existence.

It's so fucking unlucky!

At this time, Lu Daosheng had slowly walked towards the Void Hall.

On the other side.

In the Yuanji Temple.

"Damn it, don't fucking me, okay?"

When Master Yuanji looked at the image in front of him, he was what happened in the Void Palace at this time.

When he saw Lu Daosheng, Venerable Yuanji's heart was beating in his throat.

What appeared in my mind was the scene when Lu Daosheng beat him up at that time.

Thinking of this, Venerable Yuanji couldn't help but tremble slightly.

He even regretted establishing the Five Great Order Halls.

Looking at the origin of nothingness beside him, Venerable Yuan resisted the urge to slap him and quickly decided to go into seclusion and calm down.

At the same time, a message came from the Yuanji Temple with a portrait.

The other four major order halls were shocked.

"It's the Venerable, the Venerable's news!"

"What, I'm very respectful when I see this person?"

"Hiss~ Who is this that can be treated like this by Lord Venerable."

For a moment, the four major order halls were shocked and suspicious.

I don’t know how long it took, Lu Daosheng slowly walked out of the Palace of Void.

Behind him is the owner of the Xuwu Palace.

At this moment, Xu Wuzi looked a little sad, but he did not show it deliberately.

Obviously, the two reached some unequal treaty.

"Don't forget to take care of your subordinates."

"Yes, yes, yes, walk slowly."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng stood up and left, disappearing at the end of the void.

Standing in place, Xu Wuzi could not calm down for a long time.

.........

On the bustling streets, pedestrians are bustling, which looks lively and ordinary.

Two beautiful figures walked in it, becoming a beautiful landscape, attracting countless passers-by to admire it.

"Oh, isn't that Miss Lu Xue?"

At this time, someone recognized one of them.

"Miss Lu Xue, you are back!"

Everyone immediately surrounded her, all with a bit of excitement.

Seeing this, Lu Xue also smiled.

"Long time no see."

"Miss Lu Xue, who is this?"

Someone looked at Yan Lingyun beside Lu Xue. Even though Yan Lingyun deliberately concealed her aura, her temperament could not be hidden.

Everyone just approached a little and felt an inexplicable sense of oppression.

"Let me introduce you, this is my mother."

Lu Xue smiled faintly.

As soon as this was said, everyone was shocked.

Lu Xue's mother, isn't that the wife of the city lord?

Then, everyone hurriedly saluted respectfully.

"Meet the wife of the city lord."

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun nodded slightly.

At the same time, countless wilderness guards came here.

"Madam, Miss."

A captain of the wilderness guards saluted the two.

Looking at this scene, Lu Xue was a little helpless.

She actually just wanted to accompany her mother to stroll around the deserted city.

But there was no way, she was too dazzling.

Alas, there was really no way.

In the end, the mother and daughter returned to the city lord's mansion.

Because Awei Anxing and others had not returned yet, the city lord's mansion seemed a little quiet.

Fortunately, there were Xiao Yun'er and Fan Yingying and others.

"Madam, Miss, you are back!"

Seeing Lu Xue and the others, Xiao Yun'er and others were very excited.

Because that meant that Anxing and others would also be back.

As if seeing the worry in the eyes of the girls, Lu Xue smiled and said, "Don't worry, my father is back."

As soon as these words came out, everyone was stunned for a moment, and then they breathed a sigh of relief.

The city lord is actually back.

That must be fine.

In their hearts, the city lord Lu Daosheng is a true god, and there is nothing that Lu Daosheng can't do.
